title: 第二十一章 被大神统治的日子第二十二章 工作室起步
content_zh:
最新网址：新学期开始，联系王跃的业务多了起来，原本是想推掉的。可是突然想到了肖奈说过的话，“不用亲自动手，让他们自己动起来！”
转身看看宿舍三个哥们，竟然都快沉迷网络游戏了，是时候学习大神统治宿舍了！
于是在三人熟悉了软件操作后，先是让他们在自己身后学习，后来让他们试着做，最后开始慢慢的把简单的装修设计的工作，交给宿舍三个兄弟。
其实和这样的新手配合操作是非常浪费时间的，不仅要教他们软件，还要帮他们审核，还不如自己快。
为了以后能像大神一样有一个可靠的工作团队，王跃过上了既当爹又当妈的日子。
三人坚持不下去的时候，王跃就带他们去外面吃点好的，让他们对比一下有钱和没钱的生活区别。
不过当拿到第一笔为数不多的工资后，三个人总算奋发起来。不用王跃催促，知道哪里有不足之处，就自觉的去图书馆学习，一时间06届男生402宿舍，气氛为之一变。
忙碌起来的王跃，渐渐的就淡化了那份突然的心动。再看郑微的时候，也就自然了许多。毕竟不淡定的时候，一定让自己看起来淡定。
等大一快要结束的时候，张洋韩文已经能独立的去接洽装修客户了，当然还是需要王跃给把关，刘磊稍微弱些，为了让他学习，就安排他负责四个人的图纸归档。
班里其他的同学，闻风而动，有许多都向王跃表达了想跟着王跃混的意思。王跃就把几个常用软件让他们先学习这些，找张洋他们三个的图纸，学着画，等熟练了再说。后来再就没有人咨询王跃打工的事情了。不知道是没学好，还是怎么回事。
似乎是一眨眼，大一就要过完了。而王跃也在这期间，不仅要忙活装修设计的审核，还通过老客户完成了好几个大单。
建筑工程学院文艺汇演那天，王跃从自己大学附近那小区出来的时候，刚好遇到买房那天招待自己的工作人员小张。
当时小张正在收拾售楼大厅的花盆，远远的看到王跃，就跑过来打招呼，拦着王跃好一顿神侃。让王跃觉得，他就是想偷个懒。
趁他说话的间隙王跃随口就问了一句，“你们这把花盆都收拾了，是准备搬家啊？”
谁知道还被王跃一语中的，小张热情的说，“他们已经清盘结束，准备搬到新楼盘去工作。”
王跃这边才打听这售楼处卖没卖掉。
小张就开始积极推销，把这环境吹的天花乱坠。最后王跃去签合同的时候，专门要了他的电话，这人虽然油滑，但干业务，不就需要这样的吗。
王跃赶回文艺汇演大厅的时候，刚好听到郑微在那里含着泪唱《再见》，在那一刻，王跃得承认，连他都心疼了，只是不知道那个伤她的人，这会是什么感觉。
郑微唱着歌，这个小女孩在为自己的爱情告别。中途因为哽咽唱不下去的时候，阮莞上去弹着尤克里里。这一刻，王跃挺后悔，后悔没有跟着肖奈学弹琴，不然他也能上去的，解决单身可能就在今天呢！
但是就在这个时候，就看到陈孝正站了起来，向着门口走去，而王跃正好要走进去，两人交错而过。

在刚错过神那瞬间，语气严肃的说，“既然不能给她想要的幸福，就不要给她希望。”话音一落，就往后台赶去。
陈孝正的身体颤抖了一下，就又坚定的走了。
王跃赶到后台的时候，阮莞和郑微两姐妹正抱在一起。看到王跃过来，郑微擦了擦眼泪，语气抱怨的说，“你怎么来了，大忙人！”
“来研究下玉面小飞龙，是如何转化为爱哭小野猫的！”王跃忍着那份疼惜，调笑的说道。
content_en:
Latest website: At the beginning of the new semester, Wang Yue was contacted for more business, which he originally wanted to turn down. But suddenly I thought of what Xiao Nai said, "You don't have to do it yourself, let them move on their own!"
I turned around and looked at the three buddies in the dormitory. They were almost addicted to online games. It was time to learn from the masters to rule the dormitory!
So after the three of them became familiar with the software operation, they first let them learn behind their backs, then let them try it out, and finally began to slowly hand over the simple decoration and design work to the three brothers in the dormitory.
In fact, it is a waste of time to cooperate with such novices. Not only do you have to teach them the software, but you also have to help them review it, which is not as fast as doing it yourself.
In order to have a reliable work team like a great god in the future, Wang Yue lived a life of being both a father and a mother.
When the three of them couldn't hold on, Wang Yue took them out to eat something good and asked them to compare the difference between life with money and without money.
However, after receiving the first small salary, the three people finally worked hard. Without Wang Yue's urging, he consciously went to the library to study knowing where there were shortcomings. Suddenly, the atmosphere in the 402 dormitory of the 2006 boys changed.
Wang Yue, who was busy, gradually faded away from his sudden heartbeat. When he looked at Zheng Wei again, it felt much more natural. After all, when you are not calm, you must make yourself look calm.
By the end of his freshman year, Zhang Yang Hanwen was able to independently contact decoration customers. Of course, he still needed Wang Yue to check it. Liu Lei was a little weaker. In order to let him study, he was assigned to be responsible for archiving the drawings of four people.
Other students in the class were moved upon hearing the news, and many expressed to Wang Yue their intention to follow Wang Yue. Wang Yue asked them to learn some common software first, find drawings of Zhang Yang and the three of them, learn to draw, and wait until they are proficient. After that, no one asked Wang Yue about his part-time job anymore. I don’t know if I didn’t learn well or what happened.
It seems like in the blink of an eye, freshman year is coming to an end. During this period, Wang Yue was not only busy reviewing the decoration design, but also completed several large orders through old customers.
On the day of the cultural performance of the School of Architecture and Engineering, when Wang Yue came out of the community near his university, he happened to meet Xiao Zhang, the staff member who entertained him on the day he bought his house.
At that time, Xiao Zhang was cleaning up the flower pots in the sales hall. When he saw Wang Yue from a distance, he ran over to say hello and stopped Wang Yue for a chat. It made Wang Yue feel that he just wanted to be lazy.
While he was talking, Wang Yue asked casually, "You have packed up all the flower pots. Are you preparing to move?"
Who knew that Wang Yue's words would catch his attention? Xiao Zhang said enthusiastically, "They have completed the liquidation and are ready to move to a new building to work."
Wang Yue only asked if the sales office was sold.
Xiao Zhang began to actively promote the product, creating a sensation in the environment. In the end, when Wang Yue went to sign the contract, he specifically asked for his phone number. Although this man was slippery, that's what he needed to do business.
When Wang Yue rushed back to the performance hall, he happened to hear Zheng Wei singing "Goodbye" with tears in his eyes. At that moment, Wang Yue had to admit that even he felt distressed, but he just didn't know what it would feel like for the person who hurt her.
Zheng Wei sang, and the little girl was saying goodbye to her love. When he couldn't sing anymore due to choking, Ruan Wan went up to play the ukulele. At this moment, Wang Yueting regretted not learning to play the piano from Xiao Nai, otherwise he would have been able to do it, and he might have been single today!
But at this moment, I saw Chen Xiaozheng standing up and walking towards the door, and Wang Yue was about to walk in, and the two passed by each other.
At the moment when he missed God, he said in a serious tone, "Since you can't give her the happiness she wants, don't give her hope." As soon as he finished speaking, he rushed backstage.
Chen Xiaozheng's body trembledThen he left firmly.
When Wang Yue arrived backstage, the two sisters Ruan Guan and Zheng Wei were hugging each other. Seeing Wang Yue coming over, Zheng Wei wiped her tears and said in a complaining tone, "Why are you here, you're a busy man!"
"Let's study how the little jade-faced flying dragon transformed into a crybaby wild cat!" Wang Yue said teasingly, holding back the feeling of pity.
